Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. BetterSelect the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Better
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Worse'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate antonym **of the given word **"Better"** is** 3) Worse.**
 
• **Better** is a comparative form of the adjective "good." (बेहतर)
 
• **It denotes** a higher quality, more favorable condition, or improved state compared to something else.
 
• **Worse:** Worse is the comparative form of the adjective "bad."(खराब)
 
• **It signifies** a lower quality, less favorable condition, or deteriorated state compared to something else.
 
• It is the **correct antonym** of **"better."**

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Worse'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Explanation** of the options:
 
• **Verse: **Verse refers to a single line of a poem or song. (पंक्ति)
 
• **Best: **Best is a superlative form of the adjective "good." It represents the highest level of quality or superiority. (सबसे अच्छा)
 
• **Good: **Good is a positive adjective that describes something of satisfactory quality or a favorable condition. (अच्छा)
